summary.text: John Voss is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 147 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Voss is a former Procter & Gamble manager; a Democrat and a Libertarian are also on the November ballot.

paragraphs.text: John Voss graduated from Cape Girardeau Central High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in engineering management from the University of Missouri-Rolla (now Missouri S&T) in 1985.
His career experience includes working on the management team at The Procter & Gamble Corporation.
Voss took office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Wayne Wallingford.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Financial Institutions, Budget and Local Government committees.
